scope: Offline source-backed diagnostics, not end-to-end browser results

timezone.scenario: 08:00 Los Angeles meet while parent browser uses Chicago
timezone.status: reproduced in actual source callbacks; top-level save repair also verified
timezone.limit: Published guest rendering/calendar impact requires live verification because the shared writer repairs top-level fields.

dateOnlyMeet.scenario: March 6–8, 2026 date-only meet; no session time and no parsed timezone
dateOnlyMeet.status: source reconstruction exactly matches browser-reported editor values; raw model response not inspected
dateOnlyMeet.expected: Retain date range without inventing a session clock; derive/confirm venue timezone instead of applying Chicago to a Tampa meet.
causes: Date-only parsing converts dates to midnight UTC.
Explicit-time detection then finds clock-shaped text within those synthetic ISO values.
Start hydration reads literal UTC clock text; end hydration uses browser-local getters.
A missing parsed timezone retains the shell's hard-coded America/Chicago.

unmount.scenario: Unmount while an import is running; no explicit Cancel click
unmount.impact: Server endpoint persists cancellation and hides the unsaved import shell.

retry.scenario: One transient status-network error, then retry the same meet URL
retry.impact: The original import can continue on the server while retry creates and opens a second event.
